verdict.rationale: Pipecat's core is an official open-source Python SDK (pip-installable, confirmed by a runtime probe). It also ships an official family of client SDKs for web and mobile, plus pre-built React components, all documented first-party. Missing for 10: per-language detail on which client SDK platforms exist, and an official SDK for the Pipecat Cloud REST API (only a downloadable OpenAPI spec for generating your own clients is documented).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
